params.admin_: Holds every role at birth; handed to governance and the reconciler by script

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

hasPendingManualSettle(address,address).details: The trigger for the affected-user policy: while this or `isStale` is true the SuperVault pauses      deposits at vault level (pausing the deposit hook alone would not stop users buying shares at a PPS      that may still be revised). Walks the open part of the queue only.

hasUnsettledDelivery(address,address).details: The third do-not-push signal (P4): while true, a PPS push would miss value that a settle is about to      move into the wallet. Checks the instrument's bond and cash tokens.

isLotStale(uint256).details: An unconfigured age reads as stale, so the deposit gate closes on a lot nobody bounded.

isStale(address,address).details: The oldest open lot is the first to age, so this is "does any open lot exceed the age".

returns.code: 0 ok; 301 pair not approved; 302 no holding wallet for the account; 303 age not configured
0 ok; 201 pair not approved; 202 no deposit address; 203 age not configured; 204 stale         lot open; 205 per-strategy cap exceeded; 206 zero amount; 207 instrument-wide cap exceeded

proposeManualSettle(uint256,uint256,byte.details: Deliberately the ONLY way to book a loss, and deliberately slow: it is the one decrease nothing on chain      can verify. Recognising it provisionally means the delay is a review period, not a two-day head start      for holders who read the event; a cancel restores the value. The reference is reserved here so a      reconciler cannot burn it in the meantime.

recordBondsOut(address,address,uint256).details: Neither the cap nor staleness applies: an exit must stay possible. No NAV is recorded: the oracle      marks bonds in transit at the live NAV, like wallet bonds.

returns.lotId: The lot to name in the settle that closes it
The lot to name in the settle that closes it

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

rescueFromReceiver(address,address,uint2.details: Governance-trusted, like the manual settle: the normal way for a delivery to reach the strategy is a      settle. Meant for a delivery whose lot governance already wrote off, or a token that is not an      instrument's at all. Moving a live delivery this way overstates the strategy until the lot is settled.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

settleCashReturn(uint256,uint256,bytes32.details: Cash for cash: the decrease equals the sweep, no NAV involved.

settleMint(uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes.details: Checked in this order: the lot is open for at least `cashConsumed`; the bonds' value at the live NAV is      within the band [cashConsumed * (1 - fee) / (1 + maxEntryPremium), cashConsumed * (1 + maxEntryPremium)]      (`SETTLE_BELOW_NAV` / `SETTLE_ABOVE_NAV`); the reference is unused; the receiver holds `bondsReceived`      (`DELIVERY_NOT_FOUND`). `cashConsumed` is Gyld's GROSS debit for the fill, fee included: the fee is      what the band tolerates, not a separate loss. A fill outside the band is governance's to book.

params.apiRef: Gyld's `mint_request_id` (plus a fill index for partial fills), used once
params.lotId: The cash lot the order was placed against

settleRedemption(uint256,uint256,uint256.details: Same order as `settleMint`: open amount, then the band on `cashReturned` against the bonds' value at the      live NAV, [value * (1 - fee) * (1 - maxExitDiscount), value * (1 + maxExitDiscount)], then the reference,      then the receiver. A redemption that paid less is a loss (manual path); one that "paid" more than the      band is a payout for another lot being swept against this one.

params.lotId: The bond lot the redemption was placed against

settleReturn(uint256,uint256,bytes32).details: Bonds for bonds: the decrease equals the sweep.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

BOND_REGISTRY().notice: The approved-instrument list; pairs and caps are validated against it

DESTINATION_DELAY().notice: Delay on every destination CHANGE after the first set

MANUAL_SETTLE_DELAY().notice: Delay on every manual (receiver-unchecked) settle: a loss or an override

MANUAL_SETTLE_WINDOW().notice: How long after its delay a manual settle stays executable before it must be re-proposed

MAX_TRANSIT_AGE_CEILING().notice: Upper bound on `maxTransitAge`; a year-old lot is not "in transit"

MAX_TRANSIT_FEE_BPS().notice: Ceiling on the expected-fee haircut the oracle applies to in-transit value (10%).

accountOfDepositAddress(address).notice: The strategy that owns a deposit address (one Gyld account per strategy); zero when free

apiRefUsed(bytes32).notice: Every Gyld reference that has settled something (or is reserved by a pending manual settle)

cancelManualSettle(uint256).notice: Withdraw a proposal: the value comes back into the position and the reference is released.

checkBondsOut(address,address,address).notice: The strict pre-check of `recordBondsOut`, as a view

checkCashOut(address,address,address,uin.notice: The strict pre-check of `recordCashOut`, as a view, so a hook's `build()` fails the same way

depositAddressOf(address).notice: Where the account's deposits go; zero means it cannot deposit

destinationsOf(address).notice: One strategy's pair; both zero until `setDestinations`

executeManualSettle(uint256).notice: Apply a proposed decrease. Clamped to what the lot still has open (the reconciler may have settled         part of it in the meantime); a lot that closed on its own has already dropped its proposal.

getLot(uint256).notice: One lot by id; `recorded == 0` means the id was never issued

hasPendingManualSettle(address,address).notice: Whether any open lot of the pair has a manual (loss / override) settle waiting out its delay

hasUnsettledDelivery(address,address).notice: Whether Gyld has delivered something to the account's receiver that no settle has swept yet

isLotStale(uint256).notice: Whether a lot is still open and older than `maxTransitAge`

isStale(address,address).notice: Whether the account's oldest open lot for the instrument is older than `maxTransitAge`

lotCount().notice: Number of lots ever recorded; ids run from 1 to this value

lotsOf(address,address).notice: Every lot id the account ever opened for the instrument, oldest first, closed ones included

maxCashInTransit(address).notice: Per-instrument cap on OUTSTANDING cash at Gyld, per account; zero disables the instrument

maxTotalCashInTransit(address).notice: Per-instrument cap on OUTSTANDING cash at Gyld summed over every account; zero disables the instrument

maxTransitAge().notice: Lots older than this make the position stale: new deposits blocked until settled (value unchanged)

oldestOpenLot(address,address).notice: The oldest still-open lot for the pair; both zero when nothing is open

openCashLotsAt(address).notice: Open CASH_OUT lots pinned to a deposit address; while non-zero no OTHER strategy may claim it

pendingDestinations(address).notice: A proposed destination change per account; `executeAt == 0` means none pending

pendingManualSettles(uint256).notice: Pending manual settles, one per lot; `executeAt == 0` means none

pendingValuationOracle().notice: A proposed oracle change, executable after `DESTINATION_DELAY` (the first set is immediate)

previewCashOut(address,address,address,u.notice: Non-reverting twin of `checkCashOut` for the OMS. Zero means the record would be accepted.

proposeDestinations(address,address,addr.notice: Propose a change of one strategy's pair; executable after `DESTINATION_DELAY`

proposeManualSettle(uint256,uint256,byte.notice: Propose a decrease the receiver cannot back: a loss (fees, a failed order, a Gyld default) or a         delivery that reached the strategy by another route. Executable after `MANUAL_SETTLE_DELAY`, for         `MANUAL_SETTLE_WINDOW`. Valuation nets the proposed amount out from this block on.

proposeValuationOracle(address).notice: Propose a different valuation oracle; executable after `DESTINATION_DELAY`. The oracle is the         NAV every settle is tied to, so swapping it is as sensitive as re-pointing a destination: a fake NAV         would let a reconciler clear lots for dust. Hence the same delay.

receiverOf(address).notice: Each strategy's delivery receiver; created with its first destinations

recordBondsOut(address,address,uint256).notice: Record bonds sent to the redeem holding wallet as a new lot. `msg.sender` is the account.

recordCashOut(address,address,uint256).notice: Record cash sent to the deposit address as a new lot. `msg.sender` is the account.

redeemHoldingWalletOf(address).notice: Where the account's redemptions go; zero means it cannot redeem

rescueFromReceiver(address,address,uint2.notice: Move a stray balance out of a strategy's receiver into the strategy WITHOUT touching any lot.

setDestinations(address,address,address).notice: First-time set of one strategy's pair. Immediate, because nothing of that strategy's can be in         transit yet. Until this runs the strategy can neither deposit nor redeem.

setMaxCashInTransit(address,uint256).notice: Per-instrument cap on outstanding cash at Gyld. Zero disables new deposits for the instrument.

setMaxTotalCashInTransit(address,uint256.notice: Per-instrument cap on OUTSTANDING cash at Gyld across ALL strategies, immediate; zero disables the         instrument for new deposits. Bounds the chain's exposure to one instrument, on top of the per-strategy         cap. Lowering it below what is already out blocks new deposits until settles bring the total back.

setMaxTransitAge(uint256).notice: Risk tolerance, immediate. Zero is refused: it would make every record revert.

setTransitFeeBps(address,uint256).notice: Expected fee on in-transit legs for an instrument, in bps. At most `MAX_TRANSIT_FEE_BPS`.

setValuationOracle(address).notice: The oracle whose NAV ties every mint / redemption settle to the delivered value. Must bind this         registry. Until it is set, `settleMint` and `settleRedemption` revert `NAV_UNAVAILABLE`.

settleCashReturn(uint256,uint256,bytes32.notice: A cancelled deposit's cash came back from Gyld to the receiver: sweep it and clear the lot.

settleMint(uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes.notice: A mint request reached `minted`: sweep the bonds Gyld delivered to the receiver into the strategy         and clear the cash they consumed from the lot.

settleRedemption(uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: A redemption completed and Gyld paid the cash to the receiver: sweep it and clear the bonds.

settleReturn(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: A cancelled redemption: Gyld returned the bonds to the receiver; sweep them and clear the lot.

totalCashInTransit(address).notice: Sum of `cashOut` over every account, for `getTVL`

totalCashInTransitNet(address).notice: `totalCashInTransit` net of pending manual decreases, for `getTVL`

totalPendingCashDecrease(address).notice: Sum of pending manual cash decreases over every account, netted out of `getTVL`

transit(address,address).notice: The account's aggregate position for the instrument (gross of pending manual settles), with the age         of its oldest open lot. The cap and the stale gate read this.

transitFeeBps(address).notice: Expected Gyld fee on an in-transit leg, in bps, netted out of in-transit value by the oracle.

transitNet(address,address).notice: The same position NET of pending manual settles. The oracle values this, so a proposed write-down         is priced in from the proposal on.

unsweptDelivery(address,address).notice: What the account's receiver holds of the instrument's bond and cash, swept by nobody yet. The         amounts behind `hasUnsettledDelivery`, so the PPS pusher can apply a dust floor: anyone can send a         wei to a receiver, and a wei is not a reason to hold a push.

valuationOracle().notice: The oracle the settle NAV tie reads; MANAGER-set because the oracle is deployed after this contract
